//: Report-only coverage for src/renderer, run by `npm run test:coverage:renderer`. The gate lives in the `c8` block of package.json and covers src/main and src/core only; see the `//c8` note there for why the two scopes are separate. The vendor exclude belongs here rather than there, because this is the only include set that reaches it — src/renderer/vendor is bundled third-party code, not ours to cover. Reports land in coverage/renderer so they never overwrite the gate's.
//branch: Read `lines` and ignore `branches` in this report. With all:true, a module no test ever imported is synthesized as "0 of 1 branch", so the branch percentage counts only the branches of files that actually ran — it reads 81% here while a quarter of the lines are executed. The line percentage has no such artifact.
